item.title: Iran's president heads to U.N. summit ahead of possible Trump meeting
item.description: Iran's president said before departing for New York that he would "firmly defend" his country's positions at the U.N. General Assembly.

item.title: Trump to address U.N. General Assembly amid Iran, Gaza, Ukraine conflicts
item.description: President Trump is set to speak at the United Nations General Assembly as the war with Iran nears its seventh month.

item.title: Trump and Xi meet amid AI, trade and Iran tensions, seeking stability
item.description: President Trump is hosting China's Xi Jinping in Washington this week as economic and technological rivalry between the two nations intensifies.

item.title: Woman runs 'boot camp' for rescued raccoons
item.description: ABC News' Danny New visits a Mississippi wildlife rescue center where orphaned raccoons are rehabilitated and prepared for release.
